suggested_scenario_summary: Given startDate equals endDate and the half-day flag is not set, when submit() is called, then a validation error about the half-day flag is shown and the request is not saved.

justification: The status column has a DB CHECK constraint restricting it to the six defined workflow statuses, so the default branch handling an unrecognized status can never execute at runtime; the guard exists only against a future schema change, not a currently reachable state.
